description: May 7 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 2, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 7 birthday falls in Taurus, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: May 7 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Seven is the quiet, questioning number, and May 7th sets it inside an earthy sign sixteen degrees along. The Bull usually trusts the senses; seven wants to know what lies underneath them. Mercury, the decan's sub-ruler, supports careful thought. The result is often described as a grounded contemplative, someone who prefers long walks, good books and conversations that take an afternoon.

On May 7 the Sun usually sits at about 16° Taurus, in the second decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. Mercury, the ruler of Virgo, acts as sub-ruler for Taurus between 10 and 19 degrees, roughly the first ten days of May. That pairing brings a practical intelligence to the sign's patience. These Taureans are frequently pictured as craftspeople at heart: they like to learn how something works, refine it and make it last. Speech tends to be measured and grounded in specifics. The Virgoan undertone can add a critical eye, which is helpful in a workshop or a spreadsheet and sometimes less welcome at the dinner table. Their gift is turning ideas into durable, useful things that other people can rely on for years.

sections.heading: May 7 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 7th, you have a birthday number of 7 in its plain form. Numerology treats the birth day as a secondary influence, often visible in how a person thinks rather than what they do. The 7 has long been regarded as the seeker's number, linked with analysis, solitude and questions that do not have quick answers. Natives of the 7th are frequently described as observant, private and happiest when they can go deep into a subject. Time alone tends to recharge them, and trust in their intuition often grows as they learn when to stop overthinking.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one May 7 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on May 7: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 7 is the 127th day of the year (128th in a leap year). By May 21, 14 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Gemini.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 7, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on May 7 include Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky (1840), Josip Broz Tito (1892) and Władysław Reymont (1867).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 7?
faq.answer: May 7 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 7?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 7 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 7th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 7?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 7 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 7?
faq.answer: May 7 is also the birthday of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky (1840), Josip Broz Tito (1892) and Władysław Reymont (1867). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
